-- intro: {{Infobox/Magic |image= Hamon Verre Fleur.png  |title= Glass Magic |kanji= 硝子魔法 |romaji= Garasu Mahō |english= Glass Magic (VIZ, Funimation)  |user= #Hamon Caseus #Unnamed elf }} {{Nihongo|Glass Magic|硝子魔法|Garasu Mahō}} is a magic attribute that allows the user to generate and manipulate glass.
-- Description:
    This magic attribute allows the user to generate and manipulate glass at will. In order to use it to its full potential, specific spells are required, which are stored within grimoires.{{Clr}}
